entries.description: or in the widest sense
entries.subject: or

spans.text: τέχνη , from οῖκος , a house, and νόµος , rule,—the “art of household management”), the general term, with its synonym “political economy,” for the science or study of wealth (welfare) and its production, applicable either to the individual, the family, the State, or in the widest sense, the world.

entries.task_id: economic thought|in|its widest sense
entries.description: economic thought in its widest sense
entries.subject: economic thought

spans.text: How far the same considerations apply to all these spheres is one of the problems of economic thought in its widest sense.

entries.task_id: the state|in|its relation to the world
entries.description: the State in its relation to the world
entries.subject: the State

spans.text: In practice the study of “political” economy is mainly devoted to the sphere of the State; the welfare of the individual as a member of the State, and of the State in its relation to the world, being internal aspects of the prosperity of the State itself.

entries.task_id: principles have|in|fact paid?)
entries.description: principles have in fact paid?)
entries.subject: principles have

spans.text: It may be conceived either as an historical science (What principles have in fact paid?), or as an abstract science (What are the true principles which must pay, presupposing an ideal?).

entries.description: whole subject in a manner which need not here be followed
entries.subject: whole subject
entries.object: a manner which need not here be followed

spans.text: A text-book on economics necessarily deals, therefore, with the whole subject in a manner which need not here be followed, since separate articles are devoted in this work to the biographies of writers on economics, and also to the principal economic  ​ questions involved, under their own headings.

entries.task_id: in this|article|we propose therefore to confine ourselves to discussing the character and subject-matter of the science
entries.description: In this article we propose therefore to confine ourselves to discussing the character and subject-matter of the science
entries.subject: In this
entries.object: we propose therefore to confine ourselves to discussing the character and subject-matter of the science

spans.text: In this article we propose therefore to confine ourselves to discussing the character and subject-matter of the science, indicating its relation to other sciences, and explaining the methods by which economists reach their conclusions.

entries.task_id: the manner|in|which nations or other larger or smaller communities
entries.description: the manner in which nations or other larger or smaller communities
entries.subject: the manner
entries.object: which nations or other larger or smaller communities

spans.text: We understand by economics the science which investigates the manner in which nations or other larger or smaller communities, and their individual members, obtain food, clothing, shelter and whatever else is considered desirable or necessary for the maintenance and improvement of the conditions of life.

In our own day we have had many illustrations of the manner in which special circumstances may at once bring an almost unnoticed series of scientific investigations into direct and vital relation with the business world.

entries.task_id: or communities|in|question
entries.description: or communities in question
entries.subject: or communities

spans.text: It necessarily involves the scientific examination of the structure and organization of the community or communities in question; their history, their customs, laws and institutions; and the relations between their members, in so far as they affect or are affected by this department of their activity.

entries.task_id: generally current|in|a community or grade of society at a given period
entries.description: generally current in a community or grade of society at a given period
entries.subject: generally current
entries.object: a community or grade of society at a given period

spans.text: By this expression we do not mean an ideal mode of living, but the habits and requirements of life generally current in a community or grade of society at a given period.

entries.task_id: middle class|in|england
entries.description: middle class in England
entries.subject: middle class

spans.text: The standard of life of the ordinary well-to-do middle class in England, for example, includes not only food, clothing and shelter of a kind different in many respects from that of a similar class in other countries and of other classes in England, but a highly complicated mechanism, both public and private, for ministering to these primary needs, habits of social intercourse, educational and sanitary organization, recreative arrangements and many other elements.

entries.description: kind different in many respects from that of a similar class in other countries and of other classes in England
entries.subject: kind different
entries.object: many respects from that of a similar class in other countries and of other classes in England

entries.task_id: economic investigation|in|terms of money ( q
entries.description: economic investigation in terms of money ( q
entries.subject: economic investigation

spans.text: In a modern industrial community it is possible to express this standard fairly accurately for the purposes of economic investigation in terms of money ( q.v. ).

entries.task_id: of life|in|a money estimate
entries.description: of life in a money estimate
entries.subject: of life

spans.text: But it is doubtful whether the most complete investigation would ever enable us to include all the elements of the standard of life in a money estimate.

entries.task_id: experienced|in|affairs
entries.description: experienced in affairs
entries.subject: experienced

spans.text: The economist should be a man of wide sympathies and practical sagacity, in close touch with men of different grades, and, if possible, experienced in affairs.

entries.task_id: be neglected|in|economic inquiry
entries.description: be neglected in economic inquiry
entries.subject: be neglected

spans.text: No general rules, applicable to all times, can be laid down as to what phenomena must be examined or what may be neglected in economic inquiry.

entries.task_id: must be|in|touch with the actual life of the community he is studying
entries.description: must be in touch with the actual life of the community he is studying
entries.subject: must be
entries.object: touch with the actual life of the community he is studying

spans.text: He must be in touch with the actual life of the community he is studying, and cultivate “that openness and alertness of the mind, that sensitiveness of the judgment, which can rapidly grasp the significance of at first sight unrelated discoveries or events.”

entries.task_id: account of|in|economic investigation are so numerous that progress on these lines is impossible
entries.description: account of in economic investigation are so numerous that progress on these lines is impossible
entries.subject: account of
entries.object: economic investigation are so numerous that progress on these lines is impossible

spans.text: Some people are of opinion that the factors to be taken account of in economic investigation are so numerous that progress on these lines is impossible.

entries.task_id: do this|in|the world of science than it is in the world of business or politics
entries.description: do this in the world of science than it is in the world of business or politics
entries.subject: do this
entries.object: the world of science than it is in the world of business or politics

spans.text: But, as we shall see, it is no more necessary to do this in the world of science than it is in the world of business or politics.

entries.task_id: there is|in|existence a vast store of accumulated knowledge
entries.description: There is in existence a vast store of accumulated knowledge
entries.subject: There is
entries.object: existence a vast store of accumulated knowledge

spans.text: There is in existence a vast store of accumulated knowledge, and few, if any, departments of economics have been left quite unilluminated by the researches of former generations.

entries.task_id: economic work|in|modern times is carried on by consciously or unconsciously associated effort
entries.description: economic work in modern times is carried on by consciously or unconsciously associated effort
entries.subject: economic work
entries.object: modern times is carried on by consciously or unconsciously associated effort

spans.text: It must be remembered also that economic work in modern times is carried on by consciously or unconsciously associated effort, and although it must always require high qualities of judgment, capacity and energy, many of the difficulties which at first sight appear so insuperable give way when they are attacked.
